news.title: 🔴 ALERT — New 'CrashStealer' malware hijacks your Mac by faking Apple
news.excerpt: A new macOS infostealer called CrashStealer spreads through fake "Werkbit Setup" sites, impersonating Apple's CrashReporter to steal passwords, browser data, and crypto wallets. If you see "CrashReporter.dmg" in Downloads, don't open it.

news.title: 🔴 ALERT — Microsoft's July 2026 Patch Tuesday Fixes 570 Flaws, 3 Zero-Days
news.excerpt: Microsoft's July 2026 Patch Tuesday is the largest in company history: 570 flaws fixed, including 3 zero-days — 2 already exploited in the wild. If you run Windows, Office, Exchange, or SharePoint, install updates TODAY.

news.title: Six Zero-Days Live: Patch These Now
news.excerpt: Six vulnerabilities are already under active attack today (July 13, 2026) — including flaws in Adobe ColdFusion, Langflow, and a cluster of Joomla extensions. If you run any of those tools, isolate them. Everyone else: stop hitting "remind me later" on updates.

posts.headline: Stop feeding ad-trackers your data — uBlock Origin blocks ads and trackers free inside Firefox
posts.tip: Install uBlock Origin for free from `addons.mozilla.org` — open Firefox, press `Ctrl+Shift+A` to reach Add-ons, search "uBlock Origin," and click Add. Out of the box it blocks ads, cross-site trackers, and coin-miner scripts with almost no memory cost.
posts.truth: Most people don't realize the "free" web is paid for by watching everything you do. An ad-blocker isn't about killing ads — it's about stopping strangers from building a file on you.

posts.headline: Find out if your email is already in a data breach — Have I Been Pwned checks it free in 10 seconds
posts.tip: Go to Have I Been Pwned at `haveibeenpwned.com`, type your email address, and hit "pwned?" — it checks your address against billions of breached accounts and tells you exactly which breaches exposed it. No signup, no cost.
posts.truth: The honest answer is your password was probably leaked years ago in some breach you forgot about. Checking isn't scary — not checking is what gets you hacked.

posts.headline: Run private AI on your own PC — LM Studio is the free desktop app that keeps your chats off the cloud
posts.tip: Download LM Studio free from `lmstudio.ai`, install it, pick a model like Llama or Qwen from its built-in catalog, and start chatting — everything runs on your machine. No account, nothing leaves your PC.
posts.truth: Most people don't realize every "free" AI website is reading what you type. If it's private, run it locally. LM Studio makes that stupid-easy — no command line, no PhD required.

posts.headline: Your PC says it can't run Windows 11? WhyNotWin11 tells you exactly which requirement fails — free
posts.tip: Download WhyNotWin11 free from `github.com/rcmaehl/WhyNotWin11`, run the `.exe`, and it lists each Windows 11 requirement — TPM 2.0, Secure Boot, RAM, CPU, storage — as pass or fail, so you know what's actually blocking you.
posts.truth: I see this all the time — Microsoft tells you "this PC can't run Windows 11" and people assume they need a new computer. Half the time it's one setting in the BIOS. Know what's wrong before you spend a dime.

posts.headline: Your fan is screaming or your PC keeps crashing? HWiNFO shows the real temperatures, voltages and fan speeds for free
posts.tip: Download HWiNFO free from `hwinfo.com`, run it and choose "Sensors-only," and you'll see live temperatures, fan RPM, and voltages for every part — so you fix the actual failing component instead of guessing.
posts.truth: Most people don't realize a crashing PC is rarely "the whole computer." It's one hot chip or a dying fan. HWiNFO shows you the truth on screen in 30 seconds — no guessing, no expensive parts you didn't need.

posts.headline: Carry one USB for every job — Ventoy boots any ISO free, no reformatting
posts.tip: Ventoy is a free open-source tool that turns one USB stick into a multiboot drive: drop Linux, Windows, and utility ISOs onto it and pick from a menu. Install free from ventoy.net, then just copy ISO files to the USB — no reformatting.
posts.truth: Customers buy a new stick every time they need a different installer and end up with a drawer full of single-use drives. One 32GB Ventoy stick replaces all of them, and it still holds your regular files.

posts.headline: Stop trackers selling your data — uBlock Origin blocks them free
posts.tip: uBlock Origin is a free open-source blocker that kills ads, trackers, and cryptominers while sipping CPU. Add it free from addons.mozilla.org for Firefox, or uBlock Origin Lite from the Chrome Web Store for Chrome.
posts.truth: Most of those 'ads' are tracking scripts that build a profile of everywhere you go and sell it. Blocking them is a privacy move, not a convenience move.

posts.headline: Firefox 152.0.6 ships a free built-in page-summary assistant
posts.tip: Mozilla released Firefox 152.0.6 (July 14, 2026) with a Smart Window that summarizes pages plus anti-fingerprinting and location-privacy upgrades. Update free from firefox.com or click menu ☰ → Help → About Firefox.
posts.truth: Most people think 'update the browser' is busywork until a zero-day is already in the wild. The update is the cheapest insurance you'll ever buy — and the new summarize feature means you stop pasting whole articles into an AI that ships your data off.

posts.headline: Hurricane season is here — the free FEMA App sends NWS alerts for Lake City first
posts.tip: The official FEMA App pushes real-time National Weather Service alerts, locates nearby shelters, and works offline for checklists. Install free from fema.gov/mobile-products or your app store, then set your location to Lake City, FL.
posts.truth: Folks in Columbia County wait for the TV crawl and miss the window to back up the laptop and charge the power bank. A phone alert you set once beats a storm you watch arrive.

posts.headline: Run AI on your own PC with no cloud and no subscription — LM Studio is free
posts.tip: LM Studio is a free desktop app that downloads and runs open models like Qwen3 and Gemma3 entirely on your hardware — nothing leaves the machine. Download free from lmstudio.ai and chat offline in minutes.
posts.truth: Everyone's pasting client files into a web AI and hoping it's private. If it's in a browser tab, it's on someone else's server. Local AI means the data never leaves the building.
